text:
Mia (CSM): Heads up — we got a cost spike on acct 'Forklift' during onboarding. QBR next Tue. Need a short triage and clear next-step list so I can add it to the deck. Link to notes (internal): https://redwood.internal/forklift-onboard

Omar (AM): saw that. Usage is embeddings-heavy + long contexts on the search pipeline. Could be batch/default settings. I'll pull token heatmap and latest per-route stats.

cost-bot: ALERT: Account 'Forklift' projected to exceed committed credits by 28% in next 7 days. Top contributors: embeddings (62%), chat-gen (30%).

Sasha (FinOps): Can you run a quick token breakdown SQL and paste results? Example: `SELECT product, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage WHERE account='forklift' AND ts > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY product ORDER BY tokens DESC;`

Leo (Solutions Eng): I can try a quick config change on staging to validate. Likely wins: enable prefix KV cache on search route and reduce batch_size for embedding jobs. ETA ~3h for an experiment.

Mia (CSM): thanks. Omar + Leo — can you both post a short remediation plan in this thread? I need 3-4 bullets for the QBR slide (what we did, immediate config changes, and recommended next steps).

Omar (AM): Plan (short): 1) throttle embeddings ingestion to 600 TPS for onboarding window; 2) enable per-account caching for repeated queries; 3) add a budget alert at 70% of committed credits; 4) schedule 1-hr enablement with Forklift devs to review prompt shaping. I'll draft the runbook and assign owners.

Leo (Solutions Eng): Test commands I'll run (staging):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.redwood/v1/accounts/forklift/config \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  -d '{"kv_cache":true, "embedding_batch_limit":256, "ingest_rate_limit":600}'
```
Will report perf & token delta within the test window.

Sasha (FinOps): Also recommend enabling cost-aware routing so non-critical background endpoints fall back to the quantized variant (saves ~35% token cost per request). I'll attach estimated savings to the QBR slide.

Mia (CSM): solid. I'll capture these as action items. Quick q: who will present the cost slide in the QBR? @Omar?

Omar (AM): I can take it. :thumbsup:

cost-bot: NOTE: New ticket created #CS-9427 'Forklift onboarding cost triage' (owner: Omar).
